<!-- pr-reviewer: b429528626f3213d30529c3f965d7d0ca7379ffe -->
**Verdict: Needs changes before merge** - one test in the PR fails once it is merged with current main.

**What looks good**
- The #438 change itself is small and matches the body: `tool_numbers::clash_per_machine` (crates/app/src/tool_numbers.rs) groups `program_mounts(world, false)` by machine alone, so two machines may reuse a T number while two posts on one machine (one carousel) still clash. A single-machine program keeps the exact #221 message.
- No `unwrap()`/`expect()`/`panic!` in the new non-test code I read (tool_numbers.rs, posting_mounts.rs); new module has a provenance line; decision file is in `docs/decisions/`; no `CHANGELOG.md` edit; no build.rs / `.github` / scripts / dependency changes.
- Body has `Changelog:` and ends `Fixes #438`.

**Local results (PR head trial-merged with main 7e907afa, clean automatic merge, no conflicts)**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run` | builds |
| `setup_mounts_post` | **5/6 - FAIL** (6/6 on the PR head alone) |
| `setup_mount` | 6/6 |
| `posting` | 17/17 |
| `post_not_judged` | 4/4 |
| `tool_numbers` | 6/6 |
| `clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` | 342 pass, 3 fail (no GPU adapter on this host; version label `v0.0.0` vs `v0.15.0 · test` - environmental, not from this PR) |

```
test a_travel_limit_is_judged_on_the_ops_own_machine_only ... FAILED
crates/app/tests/setup_mounts_post.rs:260:9:
assertion `left == right` failed: one machine is outrun (Setup2 active): []
```

**Requested before merge**
1. `crates/app/tests/setup_mounts_post.rs:241-260` (`a_travel_limit_is_judged_on_the_ops_own_machine_only`): the test assumes the shipped VMC's Z stroke ends at 0 ("the face at 19.5 is above it"). Main's #497 / 8b54f137 moved the built-in VMC strokes to program coordinates (`assets/machines/vmc.mch`: Z now -500..500), so no limit problem is raised and the gate returns `[]`. Please merge `upstream/main`, and give the test a machine whose stroke the face really outruns (e.g. an explicit small-travel `.mch` like the existing `bench_mill()` helper), then re-run `setup_mounts_post`.
2. This PR is stacked on #471, which is still an open draft, but its base is `main`, so the diff shows all of #471's work (113 files). Please keep this PR a draft until #471 has merged and then re-merge `main`; merging it first would land #471 unreviewed.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- `tool_numbers::clash_per_machine`'s doc and `Mount::label()` use "machine, post" labels; in a multi-machine clash message the label names the first mount of that machine only. Fine, just worth knowing.
- `crates/app/src/posting.rs` is 1108 lines (over the ~400 guideline; this PR shrinks it slightly net of the new mounts module).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
